verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents a public Skills API: Skills are specified via the `container` parameter in the Messages API (up to 20 per request), and can be uploaded/managed through a dedicated Skills API endpoint, alongside SDK/plugin tooling for programmatic use. This gives AI-native users a clear, documented path to drive the product via API rather than only UI. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the API's real-world reliability and rate limits, and more detail on authentication/versioning specifics beyond the docs themselves.
